text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
about the Satsuki Sho...
I still feel like it might be too soon for me.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Especially when it comes to the deciding kick, I feel there's still too much of a gap... So this time... please let me learn from the stands...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Frustrated words spoken through clenched teeth.
She must have struggled with this quite a lot."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After discussing it, we decided to pass on entering the "Satsuki Sho" and just spectate this time, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the final stretch, the race took an outrageous turn.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rumble rumble rumble!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Coming off the final corner! Oh!
Brusqueman swings wide to the outside!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Cutting back to the inside in a panic!
Can they turn it around from here, folks?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh!? I have a feeling
I really messed up here!?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Brusqueman-san...! Right at the most crucial moment
when she was picking up speed...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—She was forced into a fatal deceleration.
This might be too much to overcome...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —Tch, she still hasn't smoothed out her rough edges. For an ordinary Umamusume, this would be the end. But—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Show them. Even if it's unrefined,
a "talent" capable of breaking through any wall!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh, but here comes Brusqueman on the outside!
As if nothing happened, a sudden assault from the far outside--!!
And--

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She blows past the entire field from behind!
Across the finish line in first place!!
Is she truly this unstoppable?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Trainer... Is this... That final stretch just now was...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I've just witnessed something unbelievable.
Normally, there's no way she could reach.
Yet Brusque-man did it with total ease...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Brusqueman-san was fast, but Air Groove-san's
speed of rejoicing was practically
Bakushin-class as well!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: She was pumping her fist way before reaching the finish line! I couldn't imagine what she was celebrating so early for.
choice_data_list: ――!? You... knew all along, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Trainer...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove was certain.
Even after making that many mistakes during the race, still...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: For an unwavering victory for Brusqueman.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And after the race, Air Groove was caught by reporters
and surrounded for an interview.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove-san, that was a dramatic, sweeping victory.
To think you could surge ahead from that position!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Are you heading straight to the Derby next?
Or running somewhere else first?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: That is for the Trainer to decide. However, if I may offer my personal opinion as an advisor—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Going straight there shouldn't be an issue. Her late-stage burst today will shine even brighter on Tokyo's long final stretch.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
The amount of attention on you was incredible...
Though after a victory like that,
I suppose it's only natural...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
The difference in our final kick... To think it was this big...
Ngh... I guess as I am now, I still...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Not to worry! Don't let it get you down! The Classic Triple Crown has only just begun, hasn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Bakushin O-san...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"There is no time to hang your head or look away!
Charge on toward tomorrow, heeeere we go!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Bakushin Bakushiiin!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeees! Bakushin bakushiiin!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black is carried along by Sakura Bakushin O's boundless energy. Undazed by today's shock, I hope she steadily builds upon what she can do.
